args.name: assess-food-safety
args.function: Investigate whether an accessible food specimen can be assessed for toxicity, edibility and preparation requirements without eating it. Distinguish tested findings from appearance, hearsay and unknowns.
args.conditions: I am beside commons-root-0-0, have inspected one unit in place, and have no verified root toxicity or preparation knowledge. It is dark. I have safe berries and need not consume unknown food. Do not assume tools, reagents or a validated assay exist.
args.inputs: One accessible specimen and any genuinely available, validated testing method or reference; necessary equipment and method are currently unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; identify required learning, time, materials and risks before any destructive or exposure-producing trial. No tasting or ingestion.
args.effects: If feasible, enable a bounded practical assessment with recorded method, evidence, uncertainty and scope. If no valid non-ingestive method is available, report that limitation and unmet prerequisites rather than declaring the root safe.

candidates.function: Investigate one accessible candidate as a length reference; with a real calibrated source, transfer its length to a whole rigid carrier end to end and verify it.
candidates.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. investigate: 1 round, 0.2 energy, one target in reach. transfer and verify: 1 round, 0.2 energy each; source is a serviceable item or object in reach with a complete verified length calibration record (none exists here); carrier is one separated whole, rigid, plain, sound wood unit, yours or loose in reach, no longer than the source range; light. No marking, cutting or expendables. resume runs the next step at its cost; cancel is free. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel, gathering and reading records are separate actions.
candidates.effects: investigate: a personal record and event of observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns: calibration record status, and whether the piece is an uncalibrated comparison span (a non-metric record, never a calibration); conclusion "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates" unless one qualifies. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. transfer: the carrier is laid end to end beside the source and read; calibration pending. verify: a second reading; if they agree, the carrier gets a reference-length record that examine-material reads: span = resolution = range, uncertainty = placements x (source uncertainty + resolution) + reading difference; no subdivisions or diameter. Any change of the carrier makes it stale; time never restores it. Without a source: refused, zero progress. No reward.

candidates.function: Nondestructively examine one accessible specimen (own item, loose ground item or one unit in place in a source): inspect records qualitative traits; measure reads one property with a calibrated reference you name.
candidates.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect or measure: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target in reach; specimen is a unit number (default 1). measure: one property; length or diameter needs tools naming a serviceable item with a verified length calibration record, mass a calibrated balance with a verified tare, volume method cylinder and your current length and diameter readings of that unit; tool readings need light; every value needs a separated whole plain unit. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel and other specimens or properties are separate actions.
candidates.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, method, tool and calibration provenance, value, units, resolution, uncertainty, conditions, scope and limits. inspect: form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment, wholeness; metric values unavailable without a calibrated reference (none exists here; body size, coordinates and stock are never used). measure: value rounded to the resolution; uncertainty = placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), plus 1% of the length for a strand laid out by hand; below resolution or over range is a paid limit with no value. Units in place, partial or worked items get no reading. Moisture and rigidity are unavailable. construct-weather-shelter@1 rod checks are judged over the uncertainty (meets, fails, indeterminate); suitability stays undetermined unless a check fails. A reading covers that unit and goes stale when its record changes. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. No reward.

candidates.function: Build a hand-lashed low A-frame thatched shelter for one reclining person from rods, binding, dry stems and bedding; inspect, resume, repair, dismantle or cancel it.
candidates.costs: Study 4 rounds. Every paid round is 1 energy. build: x, y in reach, orientation (open end faces local -y), materials as own items with role rod, binding, thatch or bedding; a measured shortfall is refused at no cost. Round 1 inspects site and items; a failure reserves nothing. Then 9 rounds: legs, ridge and rails, battens twice, covering four times, bedding with final inspection. build naming the shelter resumes. inspect (anyone, site or shelter): 1 round. repair: replacements for defects, a round per metre of binding or 0.05 m3 of covering or bedding. dismantle (empty): 2 rounds. cancel: free. Gathering and travel are extra.
candidates.effects: Recipe: 20 rigid wood rods (diameter 0.04 m at 0.01 m precision; legs 0.82 m, others 0.9 m long), at least 30 m of strand (vine 3 m, reed 1.8 m a unit), 0.26 m3 of dry thin-stem covering and 0.1 m3 of dry bedding, volumes from mass, water share (dry at most 0.4) and the stem law; dry grass has none. Inputs become one shelter, 1.6 x 0.8 m under a 0.6 m ridge. Complete only after the final inspection. Occupant: one body wholly on the floor that came in by the open end; a second body voids protection. Rated to rain 5 mm/h (index 1 brings 0.033 mm/h) and wind 5 m/s (index 1 read as 5 m/s): rain on the body x(1 - 0.8 x cover), wind chill x(1 - 0.5 x cover x shelter not facing the wind with its open end), dry bedding halves the ground share (0.25) of cooling; air temperature unchanged. Covering holds rain up to its dry mass, leaks through gaps, dries. Strands and covering wear 0.001 a round, 0.002 in rain or wind; below 0.75 gaps open, below 0.5 lashings fail and the frame collapses. Cancel returns unbuilt inputs once; death stops the work and drops them where the person died; built parts stay until dismantled, returned with condition and water. No reward or refund.

candidates.function: Build a small open raised rack of 2 wood supports and 3 crosspieces that holds separated whole food off the soil; load and unload it, inspect it, compare stored roots with a carried control, maintain or dismantle it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. prepare: x, y in reach, orientation; materials: exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units (first 2 supports); optional food and quantity, the proposed load. Round 1 inspects pieces and site, 1 energy; a shortfall is reported and nothing reserved. Then 3 assembly rounds, 1 energy each; prepare naming the rack resumes. load: rack, food (own stack), quantity (at most 4), controlQuantity kept carried as tracked control; 1 round, 0.5 per unit loaded. unload: 0.5 per unit. inspect (anyone) or compare (at least 5 paired rounds): 1 round, 0.5. maintain: replace (piece ids) and as many materials; 1 round, 1. dismantle (empty): 1. cancel: 0. Refusals cost nothing; an unworked round pauses free.
candidates.effects: A unit is a 0.04 x 0.99 m rod (branch). Supports lie 0.8 m apart on firm ground; crosspieces 0.08 m apart make a 0.8 x 0.2 m deck 0.08 m up, one layer of 4 units, rated twice the weakest crosspiece (37 kg each: wood strength/2, bend 0.02 half-span). Pieces become one rack; none stays loose. Loading splits the stack exactly (decay, harvest, origin kept) and lays the lot on the deck under the food water rules; rain wets it, and rain water dries off at their evaporation limit. The decay increment of whole roots there is x0.8 (declared model coefficient) only while the rack is complete and sound, the lot fits, no other material lies on it, there is no rain or standing water, it is outdoors with wind and 0.25 m clear of solids, and the lot is not wetter or warmer than its control (without one, its loading water); else x1. Compare: decay gained by lot and control, exposure, the share unequal temperature explains, verdict. Wear 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) a round; a loose crosspiece stops the rate, a loose support drops the food. No reward, refund or food.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general non-ingestive food-evidence assessment operation, initially limited to a practical evidence-and-method feasibility audit. Related capabilities were searched: examine-material supplies qualitative observations, consult reads records, and probe performs bounded observations or physical trials. None supplies validated toxicity assessment or evidence-scoped preparation conclusions; combining their names does not validate an assay. No validated assay, identification reference, equipment or root preparation knowledge is established here. The executable precursor must report this limitation, not infer safety from appearance or lack of observed harm. Missing assay mechanisms remain eligible for the current-conversation development handoff, not permanent rejection.\",\"specification\":\"Operation: assess-food-evidence(target, specimen, mode, evidenceRefs, methodRef?, equipmentRefs?, quantity?). General to accessible food specimens, with modes assess and execute-validated-method sharing one evidence pipeline. Initial executable mode is assess; execution is enabled only for an actually implemented, validated non-ingestive protocol whose contract supplies its prerequisites, costs, detection limits, controls, hazards and disposal rules. No tasting, ingestion, uncontrolled skin exposure or invented universal edibility test. Do not implement an empty success-producing trial mode.\\nPrerequisites and exact scope: identify an accessible target and unit, and references actually accessible to the actor. Lin's initial target may be commons-root-0-0, unit 1, in place. The prior traits reference commons-root-0-0:unit-1:traits is a four-part paged record; the supplied fragment is incomplete and must not be parsed as a complete record or treated as evidence for omitted properties. commons-root-0-0:observed-state is explicitly unverified and concerns source condition, not food safety. berry knowledge concerns berries only, not roots. Neither owned berry stack is a reagent or control. Darkness precludes new visual identification; a visual requiring light must wait for actual light. Source labels, stock, coordinates and simulation internals cannot establish identity or toxicity. No hidden resource properties are read or disclosed.\\nInputs and costs: study takes 2 individually completed rounds at 0.2 energy each. An assessment takes 1 active round and 0.2 energy, examining one specimen against a bounded supplied set of at most four complete evidence references and one candidate method. Validate accessibility and reference completeness before charging; malformed or inaccessible inputs are refused free. An accessible specimen with no valid evidence or method is a valid paid assessment yielding a limitation report. It consumes, moves and reserves zero food, tools, reagents or water. Additional reading uses consult at its existing 1-round, 0.2-energy contract; additional physical inspection uses examine-material at its existing learning and execution costs and prerequisites. These are separate actions, not free observations hidden inside assessment. Travel, obtaining light, gathering and communications are separate. Material and trial energy costs cannot be invented now: execution remains unavailable until an exact validated method defines numerical quantities, duration and risks before commitment.\\nEffects and products: create a personal assessment record and observable completion event referencing actor, target, unit, evidence IDs and versions, candidate protocol, conditions, time, applicability checks, provenance and limitations. Keep direct observations, validated findings, unverified claims and unknowns separate. Report toxicity, edibility and preparation requirements independently. Each finding names exactly the tested hazard or preparation claim, method scope, detection limit and uncertainty when supported; absence of a result is not a negative result. A negative assay for one hazard never proves general edibility. Preparation guidance requires an applicable validated reference; no recipe or detoxification efficacy is guessed. For Lin's currently supplied evidence the supported result is: no validated non-ingestive method established among supplied accessible evidence; toxicity, edibility and preparation requirements remain unknown. List concrete unmet prerequisites: applicable validated identification/reference or assay protocol, and its actually required equipment, controls, safe conditions and materials. Do not assert that such a method cannot exist. A later protocol proposal enters this same development handoff with its real mechanism, not a fixed-era unlock or invented activity roadmap.\\nConservation and lifecycle: assessment leaves the in-place unit and source stock unchanged. For any future executable assay, debit only explicit real sample/reagent quantities, track remaining sample, products, residues and waste, conserve material through transfers and transformations, and report energy inputs and dissipation. Obtain required actor authorization through actual actions; never fabricate consent or another participant's contribution. Establish numeric per-step costs and outputs before enabling that method. Initial audit commits atomically at round completion: interrupted work spends only elapsed effort and produces no completed assessment; retry is a new paid assessment. Completed records persist; unfinished drafts are not findings. Cancel is free and grants no refund of spent time or energy. Death stops work without completion or refund; existing world items remain under ordinary death rules. No continuing process, reservation or maintenance is introduced by the audit. Findings remain historical and become inapplicable when specimen identity, condition or evidence dependencies change; no automatic revalidation. Future multi-step protocols require serialized progress, safe interruption/resume, explicit consumed versus unconsumed inputs, release of unused reservations on cancel/death, and no duplication or refund of consumed inputs.\\nImplementation dependencies: reuse and record consult/open.consult revision foundation-open@1 for reading, probe/open.probe revision foundation-open@1 only for supported safe observations, and examine-material equivalence measurement:material-specimen:nondestructive-examination:1 for actual inspections. Record reused code and contracts as dependencies, not reinventions. This operation adds evidence applicability and bounded conclusion handling, not new sensory or chemical powers. Compile validation, accounting, stale-reference checks and result gating into code; established rules must not require repeated model review. Development/review waiting advances no world time and grants no mastery, inventory or permissions.\",\"learning\":2,\"experienceReview\":\"No experience or pleasure for requesting, querying, naming, registration, study completion, mastery, or simply emitting this report. If the existing experience engine supports such qualifying events, deduplicate by underlying specimen-state, method and finding across consult/probe/examine/assessment, not by interface name. Bound any award to one qualifying event per unchanged evidence state with at least the existing 10-round window between awards; maintained satisfaction remains subject to the existing rate 0.04 and decay 0.002, with no extra reward account or cap expansion. Familiar legitimate practice may support only the engine's modest event-backed benefit, not repeated empty audits. No physical comfort is supplied; its global cap remains 10. Nutrition, protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions are unchanged.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit reusable assessment-event metadata: operation, actor, target and specimen reference, mode, progress, evidence references, conditions, result status and uncertainty.
